speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cat Scratch Disease with Paratenonitis.

The combination of your recent camping trip, the self-resolving knee pain (likely a prior bite site), and the new wrist pain with skin lesions strongly suggests a cat scratch infection spreading to the tendon sheath, even though your initial labs and X-rays are normal.
